question: Who wrote the treatise on politics, "Arthashastra"?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kautilya.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Arthashastra was written by Chanakya.
 
• Chanakya, also called as Kautilya **and** Vishnugupta.
 
• He was a scholar at Takshashila and teacher and guardian of emperor of Chandragupta Maurya of Mauryan Empire.
 
• Arthashastra is an ancient Sanskrit book on statecraft, political science, military strategy and economic policy.
 
• After its disappearance around 12th century, it was rediscovered in 1905 by R. Shamasastry. 
 
• **He published it in** 1909, **The** english translation of Arthashastra** was also done by** Shamasastry.
